# OM Shakthi Catering Services

> Traditional South Indian catering for weddings, receptions, corporate events and house functions, based in Tamil Nadu, India.

This site is a single offer landing page: a visitor enters their mobile number to
instantly reveal an exclusive discount (a scratch-card coupon) for booking an event.
